purpose: Expand a statement beyond the first named item.
keywords: N / plain clause / な-adjectiveである + のみならず
It was acclaimed abroad as well as at home.
He not only conducted research but continued mentoring junior colleagues.
This tool is not only light but also sturdy.
formation: N / plain clause / な-adjectiveである + のみならず
restrictions: Often paired with も in the additional clause.
mistake: The additional statement should extend the same overall point.
